description: This file declares the exported API functions for an Object Array component within a broader system, providing prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateObjectArrayComponent
methods.description: Creates an object array component with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayCOCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the object array component, initializing necessary context handles.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayCORemove
methods.description: Removes the specified object array component instance.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects within the object array component.
